blocker_explanation: HTTP 401 Unauthorized: The Roboflow dataset 'ag-spill/spill-detection-zlhyl' is not an open anonymous download. Roboflow Universe requires an authorized API key to generate download tokens and export the raw 4,580 images.
configuration_steps: 1. Create or log in to your Roboflow account at https://roboflow.com
2. Retrieve your Roboflow Private API Key from https://app.roboflow.com/settings/api
3. Set the environment variable: export ROBOFLOW_API_KEY="your_key_here"

class_semantic_audit.spill: Images containing liquid puddles (water, oil, beverage spills) on indoor walking floors.
class_semantic_audit.floor floor floor: Normal, dry, clean floor surfaces without liquid pools. The triplicate naming is a known Roboflow classification labeling convention.
